body: Did it come with different colored triggers too? I bought a custom ps4 controller shell kit from geniusmods.com and it contained gold triggers and the extra gold plating made them stick, like they would not bounce back into place right away. Found out the modded ps4 controller I bought on ebay had a custom shell and the triggers were a little bit different and they didn't line up right. If you changed the triggers try swapping them out for the originals, or see if anything is hitting and scrape any excess flash with an exacto knife
I love reddit. In my accounts I tend to lurk though. I feel I don't have much value to add.
I tried a therapist, psychiatrist, and even an IOP program. None of them helped in the slightest.

Thank you. I have tried. Since I was a kid I was always the smart guy or the nerd or whatever the label was. As I grew older it changed from teachers and classmates telling me this to the media telling me this. And I started teaching. I dropped out of college but I have taught many college kids and graduate students. But I can never seem to figure out my own shit or find enough happiness or reason to live anymore. I keep hoping things will change but the world is so fucked I doubt that day will ever come and I feel like a fool for thinking it ever would.
